name: RC-B10-0372/2025 – § 15 – Am 10
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text: 15. Considers it essential to carry out a full investigation into all war crimes and violations of international law, and for all those responsible to be held to account;
